name: Split Bone Necklace
summary: Kin'weelay at Grom'gol Base Camp sends you southeast to hunt the Skullsplitters. The Darkspears left Stranglethorn Vale, yet their old feud with these jungle rivals continues. Bring back twenty-five split bone trophies to aid the Darkspears and earn their friendship.

sections.title: An Unbroken Feud
sections.body: After the Bloodscalp hunt, Kin'weelay turns to another old enemy. Southeast of Grom'gol Base Camp, the Skullsplitter tribe has fought the Darkspears for many years. The Darkspears no longer live in Stranglethorn Vale, yet they remain bound to this war.

sections.title: Trophies of War
sections.body: You travel into Skullsplitter territory to claim twenty-five split bone necklaces and earn the Darkspears' friendship and respect. Kin'weelay takes pride in seeing these hostile trolls cut down like young saplings by a basilisk. Each trophy you bring back counts as a victory for his people.

faq.q: Who offers this hunt, and where is he located?
faq.answer: Kin'weelay offers the hunt from Grom'gol Base Camp, a Horde outpost on Stranglethorn Vale's western coast.

aliases: prior quest to split bone necklace
faq.answer: This hunt follows Bloody Bone Necklaces, when Kin'weelay sent adventurers after trophies from the Bloodscalp tribe.

faq.q: Why do the Darkspears fight the Skullsplitters if they left Stranglethorn Vale?
faq.answer: The Darkspears and Skullsplitters fought for years in the jungle. Though the Darkspears left Stranglethorn Vale, Kin'weelay says they remain bound to the conflict and mean to make their foes regret starting it.

faq.q: Where can the Skullsplitter tribe be found?
faq.answer: The Skullsplitter tribe lives southeast of Grom'gol Base Camp in Stranglethorn Vale.

faq.q: What proof does Kin'weelay demand from the hunt?
faq.answer: Kin'weelay asks for twenty-five Split Bone Necklaces taken from fallen Skullsplitter trolls.

angles.text: As a Horde ally, helping Kin'weelay at Grom'gol Base Camp in the war against the Skullsplitters earns the Darkspears' friendship.
As a Darkspear troll, taking trophies from the Skullsplitters carries on a long war that did not end when your tribe left Stranglethorn.
